author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex
statement: Given the source master rank/recurrence contracts and uniformly polynomial-workspace root and crossing-factor evaluators with their time costs charged, the field-clique recursion has a depth-first nonmemoizing executor using polynomial workspace and the source master time envelope up to charged polynomial factors. Sequential CRT preserves this query-level space under its own polynomial-workspace hypotheses. No full SAT space guarantee or improved exponent is claimed.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size query workspace and time argument
Complete workspace analysis of fixed- and general-density reductions including sparsification
A better crossing family satisfying both rank and streamability contracts
